title: Add installer core

context.summary: Introduce the non-interactive installer foundation used by later wizard and bootstrap tasks.
context.background: The one-command installer needs a deterministic core before prompts exist: answer files, dependency detection, config rendering, transaction journaling, rollback ordering and redacted summaries.

in: Add @mindory/installer package with install plan and answer file types.
Implement transaction journal recording and rollback execution primitives.
Implement host dependency detector for Docker, Compose, Node/pnpm and writable MINDORY_HOME.
Implement config/env/Compose asset rendering helpers from answers and config catalog.
Implement redacted install summary output that hides secrets.
Add validator coverage for installer core behavior and boundaries.
out: Real release download and signature verification.
Installer signal handling and resume/repair commands.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/installer exposes answer file, install plan, journal, rollback, dependency detection, render and summary APIs.
Transaction rollback runs completed actions in reverse order and records rollback outcomes.
Dependency detection can operate in dry-run/test mode without mutating the host.
Rendered config and env output derive from the config catalog and redact secrets in summaries.
Installer core validator covers journal rollback ordering, answer validation and redaction.
No interactive prompts or bootstrap scripts are included.

manual_checks: Confirm no installer prompt UI or shell bootstrap scripts are added.

risks: Installer core must be deterministic and testable without touching system dependencies.
Secrets must not appear in redacted summaries.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
